    rows, cols = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    visited = [[False]*cols for _ in range(rows)]
    components = []
    
    for color in range(10):
        if color == 9:  # Skip background
            continue
        
        # Find all pixels of this color (could be separate components)
        for r in range(rows):
            for c in range(cols):
                if grid[r][c] == color and not visited[r][c]:
                    # Start BFS
                    component = []
                    queue = [(r, c)]
                    visited[r][c] = True

                        cr, cc = queue.pop(0)
                        component.append((cr, cc))
